import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots for comprehensive customer segmentation insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Income distribution by Education Level
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
education_order = df.groupby('Education')['Income'].median().sort_values(ascending=False).index
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Education', y='Income', order=education_order, palette='Set2', ax=ax1)
ax1.set_title('Income Distribution by Education Level', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Education Level', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Income ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Age distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
current_year = 2014  # Based on sample data dates
df['Age'] = current_year - df['Year_Birth']
ax2.hist(df['Age'], bins=30, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=11)
ax2.axvline(df['Age'].median(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f'Median: {df["Age"].median():.0f}')
ax2.legend()

# 3. Total spending by product category
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :2])
spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
total_spending = df[spending_cols].sum()
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', len(spending_cols))
bars = ax3.bar(range(len(spending_cols)), total_spending, color=colors, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(spending_cols)))
ax3.set_xticklabels(['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold'], rotation=45, ha='right')
ax3.set_title('Total Spending by Product Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Total Spending ($)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_xlabel('Product Category', fontsize=11)
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
             f'${height/1000:.0f}K', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 4. Purchase channel preference
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
channel_cols = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases']
channel_totals = df[channel_cols].sum()
colors_pie = ['#ff9999', '#66b3ff', '#99ff99']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(channel_totals, labels=['Web', 'Catalog', 'Store'], 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors_pie, startangle=90)
ax4.set_title('Purchase Channel Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 5. Income vs Total Spending scatter
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :2])
df['TotalSpending'] = df[spending_cols].sum(axis=1)
scatter = ax5.scatter(df['Income'], df['TotalSpending'], 
                     c=df['Age'], cmap='viridis', alpha=0.6, s=30)
ax5.set_title('Income vs Total Spending (colored by Age)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Income ($)', fontsize=11)
ax5.set_ylabel('Total Spending ($)', fontsize=11)
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax5)
cbar.set_label('Age', fontsize=10)

# Add trend line
z = np.polyfit(df['Income'].dropna(), df.loc[df['Income'].notna(), 'TotalSpending'], 1)
p = np.poly1d(z)
x_line = np.linspace(df['Income'].min(), df['Income'].max(), 100)
ax5.plot(x_line, p(x_line), "r--", alpha=0.8, linewidth=2, label='Trend')
ax5.legend()

# 6. Campaign acceptance rates
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
campaign_cols = ['AcceptedCmp1', 'AcceptedCmp2', 'AcceptedCmp3', 'AcceptedCmp4', 'AcceptedCmp5', 'Response']
acceptance_rates = df[campaign_cols].sum() / len(df) * 100
colors_bar = sns.color_palette('coolwarm', len(campaign_cols))
bars = ax6.barh(range(len(campaign_cols)), acceptance_rates, color=colors_bar, edgecolor='black')
ax6.set_yticks(range(len(campaign_cols)))
ax6.set_yticklabels(['Camp 1', 'Camp 2', 'Camp 3', 'Camp 4', 'Camp 5', 'Response'])
ax6.set_title('Campaign Acceptance Rates', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Acceptance Rate (%)', fontsize=11)
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    width = bar.get_width()
    ax6.text(width, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2.,
             f'{width:.1f}%', ha='left', va='center', fontsize=9)

plt.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
